title: Select a resource
browseHelp: Browsing a domain does not change your active session. Select a project to switch both together.
empty: No matching authorized projects. Try All, change your search, or recover hidden resources in display settings.
preferencesHelp: Pins, ordering, hidden items and recent selections are saved only in this browser for your account and identity domain. They never grant access. Hidden resources remain available here; the active scope always stays visible. Move controls reorder the displayed results.
storageFailed: Browser storage is unavailable. Display changes apply only while this selector remains open.
createDenied: You do not currently have permission to create projects in this domain.
loadFailed: Could not verify current resource access. Refresh inventory before selecting or creating resources.
switchFailed: Could not switch workspace. Refresh inventory and try again.
createRejected: Creation was rejected. Check your input and current permissions before submitting again.
createUncertain: The creation outcome is unknown. Do not submit again. Close this form and refresh inventory to check for the resource.
tutorialUnavailable: Resource switching and creation are unavailable in the tutorial.
